evidence.name: Screen field: How see-through the bar is
evidence.userNeed: Know what "How see-through the bar is" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: How see-through the bar is
sections.description: Sets how transparent the bar's background is, from fully see-through to fully solid (only applies when the bar is shown). Keep it near solid to keep the CTA crisp and readable; lower it for a softer, glass-like look that lets content show through. Avoid going very transparent — if the button blends into scrolling content, visitors may miss it and you lose clicks.
